title: Built to fold, tested to last: How Samsung has refined foldable durability across eight generations
summary: As foldable smartphones evolve, the conversation goes beyond how a device looks or how thin it can be. What matters is how its design, materials, and components work together through everyday use.…

blocks.text: As foldable smartphones evolve, the conversation goes beyond how a device looks or how thin it can be. What matters is how its design, materials, and components work together through everyday use. With eight generations of foldable innovation, Samsung continues to refine its Galaxy Z series around this principle, bringing together durability, versatile screen experiences, and devices designed for different users and needs.
Engineering a Foldable for Everyday Life

A refined foldable experience starts with more than a slim profile. Samsung engineers the complete device, balancing materials, structure, weight, ergonomics, durability, battery, and thermal performance as one integrated system.

The Galaxy Z Fold8 reflects this approach with a lightweight 201-gram design that measures just 4.5mm when unfolded and 9.7mm when folded. Its engineering combines Flex Titanium beneath the folding display with an Advanced Armor Aluminum frame, helping support a slimmer form factor while maintaining structural strength.

Durability is also evaluated through more than 100 reliability validation tests across the latest Galaxy Z series. These include tests involving repeated folding, drops, pressure, moisture, and debris, assessing how the device performs under different stresses associated with everyday use.
Making More of the Larger Screen

Durability is one part of the foldable experience; making the most of the larger screen is another. Across eight generations, Samsung has continued to turn additional screen space into practical experiences for work, creativity, and entertainment.

On the Galaxy Z Fold8, multi-window capabilities let users work across apps, while Galaxy AI features offer additional ways to interact with information on a larger canvas. A foldable-optimized camera experience supports content creation, while Samsung DeX provides a desktop-like environment for compatible workflows.

App optimization is also key to making the larger display more useful. With continued optimization for the foldable format, compatible apps can better adapt to the Galaxy Z Fold8’s expansive screen, supporting a more seamless experience across multitasking, productivity, and entertainment.

Together, these features make the expanded display useful beyond simply viewing content. From managing a busy day to creating and enjoying content, the larger screen is designed to help users do more with the space available to them.
A Foldable for Different Needs

Samsung offers more than one answer to the foldable category, with a portfolio of proven, available devices designed around different users, use cases, and levels of capability. The Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra delivers the complete flagship package, bringing together an expansive display, an advanced camera system, and premium performance. The Galaxy Z Fold8 offers an immersive large-screen experience for content consumption, from watching videos to browsing and enjoying entertainment on the go. Meanwhile the Galaxy Z Flip8 features a compact form factor for those who value portability and everyday convenience.

Each device brings its own combination of features and experiences, giving consumers options based on how they work, create, communicate, and enjoy content. This breadth reflects Samsung’s continued investment in foldables—not as a one-size-fits-all category, but as a range of experiences shaped around different needs.
